categories.rationale: Stage 1 changes no verb, objective, copy or beat predicate (diff confined to main/src/audio, tools, tests). The era ladder the story tells is honoured: bare and colour renders fingerprint-identical, story-beat mood level delta I -0.23. Agency untouched; camera taken zero times.

The awakening earns its weight in sound as it does in image (+4 LU at alive, +4 dB body at 120-300 Hz, mono sub, air) and the fidelity ladder is one event across ear and eye. But the contracted peak gesture (BLOOM -14 short-term) does not land, and whether the widened era-transition LRA (11.17 -> 15.18) reads as weight or lurch is unheard.

No image term moves; shipped focal subjects, camera authority and FOV are untouched by construction (diff scope), not by audit. Scored from the diff, held below 5 because parity is asserted by scope rather than captured.

Harmonic authority, motif and voice leading untouched; SYMPHONY LAW clean; six shipped clicks removed; blind reader: same piece, better built. Unmet: BLOOM short-term window; night bed 0.5 LU over band; colour inaudibility stated to 0.5 but proven to 0.38; three graph deviations unreconciled in the treatment.
Sound-as-rendering holds: every new rail gates on padChoir, story convolver on richness, so the bare and colour eras carry no room, width or drive they have not earned; PostFX and grade untouched.

Era-build and story-handoff sweeps 0 violations; endOfflineScoreRender determinism reset; bounded oscillator lifetimes. Gaps: no unit test protects the era-gate zero or glue topology; ~12 ms cumulative music-path latency is a forward hazard for Stage 3/4; sandbox probe not run at Stage 1.

A bespoke instrument, not a preset: era-gated drive wet, seeded per-voice wander, breath on retune, exact-bypass LR4 mono-below, shared seeded impulse generator. Blind reader: 'the most professional-sounding change in the set' (mono bass), yet 'gain spread evenly rather than arriving in gestures' - the ambition is the ladder, not yet the peak.

Lean tier rendered independently and in band (-19.85 LUFS, corr 0.892); story-beat lean fingerprint-identical to full. Three lean voices equal the shipped count. Reduced motion and mobile viewport not applicable to an audio-only diff. Lean at 4x throttle not yet proven (D3).

score:fps median 60.39 PASS, 41/41 targeted tests, verify green, implementation matches the contract graph with three documented deviations. But the contracted audio-thread ms/frame budgets (1.5 full / 3 lean at 4x throttle) are unmeasured against a 1.7x DSP cost, and a hard-coded Chrome makeup figure has no gate.

Self-incriminating deviation log, independent re-measurement that caught a claim overreach (2 LSB vs 1), a blind report that declares its limits. Weakened by two unfilled templates and an unrecorded story-audit skip.
